note: Six files, six windows, one post each. The poster imports and drives; tiktok-audit.ps1 -Run NAME is the observer, unchanged. compare_runs.py --normalize --container INPUT is the readout.

landmines.sourceType: Every file arm is library=import. PHAsset.sourceType is the library's claim. EXIF stamping cannot make Photos call an import a camera original. 01-native as a laptop file that we import is a native-looking import, not a camera original.
landmines.fidelity: If import rewrites, the laptop dump is fiction. dump_tags on the pulled DCIM file is then the denominator for INPUT.
landmines.one_post: A second post in the same runs/NAME/ blends the tally. Spent windows are refused.
landmines.burner: Test on a burner. Semi-tethered: a reboot drops Frida and sshd until palera1n is re-applied.
